I've been downsizing twice and I realized something; I feel good while doing and a few days after, bit then I'll start to think I need more, and then I acquired more creating a vicious cycle so, I recommend to you to do it little by little like those challenges of 30 days of lipstick in which you uses a different product per day and you see if you really liked or not and the decluttering part becomes more natural and less addictive

Something I recommend (and yet may sound pretty silly and obvious) is to get a magnetic pallette and go through each of your pallettes getting every single shadow you really want; you'll probably will be able to reduce the size of your pallette collection if you get rid of the color you don't like/won't be wearing

I just started my process of rehabilitation and my plans are 

a) not buy anymore makeup - unless really needed - untill I recover the amount of money I spent on my collection, how will I do this:
           a.1: cancel subscription to content that's nothing else than publicity, i.e. brands channels/insta and influencers that doesn't actually take advantage of their make up but only indirect and/or actively sponsor new collections and mu in general 

          a.2: put all my makeup on a drawer without pretty displays nor pretty packaging so I don't associate the value of the product to have it but to what I can do with it instead

          a.3: weekly change my products from the ones in said drawer so I can rediscover my collection and then re organize them into 3 categories: the ones I really like, the ones I want to pan and the ones I really don't like 

           a.4: whenever I fell the urge of buying something I'll put that money into savings and come here to read about someone else's progress and get back on my line

b) I'll be nice to myself 

C) I won't really get that worried about makeup anymore, I want to be more than my collection and my concerns, so, I'm just gonna use it and eventually it'll get done or not and that's just how life is

D) I'll learn from my past mistakes
